messages:
Alex Chen: FYI — I sketched a proposal for per-model/route latency & throughput SLO dashboards. Need infra + runtime input on metric availability and cardinality.

Maria Gonzalez: Nice. What SLOs are we targeting? P50/P95/P99 + TTFT + tokens/sec?

Alex Chen: Exactly. Proposed metrics:
- `inference_request_duration_seconds` (histogram)
- `inference_time_to_first_token_seconds` (summary)
- `tokens_generated_total` (counter)
- `request_tokens_count` (counter)
- `inference_inflight_requests` (gauge)

Samir Patel: Do we have those exact names in prometheus today? I think runtime exports `rpc_latency_seconds_bucket` and `tokens_produced_total`.

Jen López: Runtime: we currently emit `rpc_latency_seconds_bucket` and `ttft_seconds` (summary) but not tokens/sec. Tokens/sec has to be computed: rate(tokens_produced_total[1m])

Alex Chen: ok — so mapping:
- use `rpc_latency_seconds_bucket` -> compute P50/P95/P99 via histogram_quantile
- `ttft_seconds` -> P50/P95/P99 from summary
- `tokens_produced_total` -> rate(...) for tokens/sec

InfraBot: Note: high cardinality labels (model, route, model_version, tenant_id) will increase prometheus series. Recommend rollup labels: `{model, route, model_version}`; tenant-level only for sampled dashboards.

Kevin Wu: If we aggregate at `{model, route}` we can compute per-route SLOs without exploding series. For per-tenant SLOs we can use metrics sampling + trace linkage.

Maria Gonzalez: Console UX: key view should be a list of routes with sparkline + current P95 + alert status. Clicking route opens a per-model detail with TTFT and tokens/sec.

Samir Patel: Example PromQL for P95:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(rpc_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))
```
For TTFT (summary):
```
quantile_over_time(0.95, ttft_seconds[5m])
```

Jen López: Note: `quantile_over_time` on summaries is expensive; prefer histograms when possible.

Alex Chen: Alerting: thresholds per-model (start with P95 < 300ms for small models, < 800ms for larger). Need infra to propose sensible defaults.

Ops: We should also add synthetic heatmap probes to get baseline per-region latency.

Kevin Wu: For rollout UX: dashboard should show candidate vs baseline overlay during canary. Need model_version label in all metrics to switch between versions.

Maria Gonzalez: Data retention: keep high-res (1s) for 24h, 1m for 30d for dashboards that require granularity. OK?

InfraBot: Prometheus retention config note posted: `prometheus.yaml` updated to 30d for 1m samples. (link)

Samir Patel: Implementation tasks:
- runtime: ensure `model_version` label on all metrics (owner: Jen)
- infra: add tokens_produced_total and retention config (owner: Kevin)
- devex: design list + detail UI mockups (owner: Maria)
- sre: define alert baseline (owner: Ops)

Jen López: Will add `model_version` and normalize metric names this week. PR: https://git.internal/r/1234

Alex Chen: Next sync Wed 10am. Agenda: finalize PromQL, default thresholds, and console wireframes. Thx :thumbsup:

Maria Gonzalez: +1

Samir Patel: +1

Kevin Wu: noted

Ops: added to calendar
